_source: Kruger, Elder, Gates et al., Planar coil design for the Helios stellarator fusion power plant, Fusion Eng. Des. 230 (2026) 115893, Table 2 (encircling coils) and Sec. 4.1. L = 36 m is the paper's AVERAGE encircling-coil length, used here as a per-coil cap (user's choice, 2026-09-16). The paper has no kappa_MS bound. convex_excess: allowed total-curvature excess per coil, int |kappa| ds - 2 pi (paper Eq. 5), in radians. || helios_L28 = paper bounds EXCEPT L 36->28. Base rung of the dual length+corner ladder.
